summary: LSDJ Burrito runs Little Sound Dj on the FM-1, played from its keys and knobs, with songs saved to flash and extra per-channel and master effects. LSDj itself is not included: you add your own ROM through the web page.
features: Bring your own LSDj ROM; 9.3.9 is the verified version
Per-channel filters, drive, lo-fi and an LFO; master echo, reverb, compressor
MIDI clock in and out, MIDI notes and CCs
Web page for install, live control, song and kit tools, game controller
